pull.title: p2p: Track recent stale tips (BIP 332)
pull.body:
Part of #36833

This PR adds local tracking of recent stale tips for [BIP 332](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0332.md).
The feature is behind a new `-staletips=<mode>` option (default `none`). There is no P2P change yet: with `-staletips=headers` the node only tracks tips.

### Key changes

* A new `AcceptedStaleTip` validation notification feeds the staletips tracker.
* The tracker is built from the block index at startup, keeping the tips with the most work.
  *  At most 10 tips are tracked. When the tracker is full, a new tip evicts the one with the least work, but only if the new tip has more work.
* `getchaintips` RPC updates
  * Add new options `max_depth` and `staletips_only`
  * Report `fork_point` for each non-active tip.

Test networks get the stricter policies the BIP recommends:
* **signet:** only tips whose block has been validated, and one header variant per block. 
* **testnet3/4:** only tips with a difficulty of at least about 1,000,000.

<details>
<summary>Sample output (regtest, after a reorg replaced the tip at height 111)</summary>

```
$ bitcoin-cli getchaintips
[
  {
    "height": 112,
    "hash": "544a1c7f23c96990e2db9f4415f498d1ee61effac8e7416ec53fb91f538b2d2c",
    "branchlen": 0,
    "status": "active"
  },
  {
    "height": 111,
    "hash": "3a0797803400d80abdbf34f73df33f760c1e24696531746f975e3041055b6967",
    "branchlen": 1,
    "fork_point": "43765e057b6cde12df1701595d90ae51cf80490fef1343edd2d3fbe2edf3958e",
    "status": "valid-fork"
  }
]

$ bitcoin-cli -named getchaintips staletips_only=true
[
  {
    "height": 111,
    "hash": "3a0797803400d80abdbf34f73df33f760c1e24696531746f975e3041055b6967",
    "branchlen": 1,
    "fork_point": "43765e057b6cde12df1701595d90ae51cf80490fef1343edd2d3fbe2edf3958e",
    "status": "valid-fork"
  }
]
```

</details>

events.message:
validation: add AcceptedStaleTip notification

Notify validation interface listeners when a header or block is
accepted that is not on the active chain and has no more work than
the active tip. BIP 332 stale-tip tracking, added in later commits,
uses this.

Headers from one ProcessNewBlockHeaders() call are coalesced into one
notification for the last new header. A block is notified again when
its data is stored.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

staletips: add bounded stale-tip tracker

Add StaleTipTracker, which keeps up to MAX_ADVERTISED_STALETIPS
recent stale tips that are eligible for relay under BIP 332. When
full, it evicts the tip with the least work.

Add BlockTree to test/util/blocktree.h so later tests can share it.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

events.message:
staletips: apply test-network tracking policies

Test networks are less protected by proof of work, so BIP 332
recommends stricter stale-tip policies there. On signet, only track
tips whose block has been validated, and one header variant per
block. On testnet3 and testnet4, only track tips with a difficulty
of at least about 1,000,000.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

staletips: seed tracker from the block index

The tracker is not persisted, so add SeedFromBlockIndex() to rebuild
it at startup from the eligible stale tips in the block index.
Candidates go through AddStaleTip(), so the same policies apply as
at runtime.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

init: add -staletips option

Add -staletips=<mode> to opt in to BIP 332 stale-tip relay. For now
'headers' only enables stale-tip tracking, which the next commits
add; later PRs add relay behind the same mode.

Make the PeerManager ApplyArgsManOptions() return util::Result, like
the other ApplyArgsManOptions() helpers, so an invalid mode is
reported at startup.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

net_processing: track local stale tips

When -staletips is enabled, track the stale tips this node learns
about.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

rpc: add max_depth and fork_point to getchaintips

Add an optional max_depth argument that limits getchaintips to tips at
most that many blocks below the active tip, and report fork_point for
each tip that is not on the active chain.

This lets callers find recent forks without listing every old stale
branch on mainnet or walking back each branch to its fork point.

rpc: report tracked stale tips in getchaintips

Add a staletips_only argument to getchaintips that lists only the
recent stale tips the node tracks with -staletips, taken from the
stale-tip tracker.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>
